t: The colonial state formed when the Dutch government took over the VOC’s Asian possessions on 1 January 1800.
The Cultivation System of 1830 forced Javanese villages to grow export crops, making the colony highly profitable for the Netherlands.
Conquest of the outer islands by about 1910 created the borders that independent Indonesia inherited in 1949.
dyk: Eduard Douwes Dekker, a former colonial official, attacked the Cultivation System in the 1860 novel Max Havelaar, published under the pen name Multatuli.
ev: The Dutch state takes over the possessions of the dissolved VOC
Britain occupies Java under Thomas Stamford Raffles
Prince Diponegoro leads the Java War against Dutch rule
Johannes van den Bosch introduces the Cultivation System
The Dutch invade Aceh, beginning a decades-long war
Queen Wilhelmina announces the Ethical Policy
Japan conquers the colony; the Dutch surrender on 8 March
The Netherlands transfers sovereignty to Indonesia on 27 December

f.founder: The Dutch state (Batavian Republic), on the VOC’s dissolution
f.successor: Indonesia (United States of Indonesia); Netherlands New Guinea
